# TenantRetentionSource

Where a tenant's run retention comes from.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"PlatformDefault"` | The tenant has no override: the platform default applies. |
| `"TenantOverride"` | The platform's administrators set an override for this tenant. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`TenantRetention`](tenant-retention.md)
